svg.data-vd-steps: [[0, "A population of bacteria. By chance (a random mutation) a few are resistant to the antibiotic (red)."], [3, "The antibiotic is used: it kills the susceptible bacteria (green). The resistant ones survive."], [7, "The survivors reproduce by binary fission, passing on the resistance allele."], [11, "Soon most of the population is resistant: natural selection. The antibiotic no longer works."]]
svg.title: Antibiotic resistance
svg.desc: A bacterial population with a few resistant cells; the antibiotic kills the susceptible ones; the resistant ones multiply until the population is mostly resistant.
svg.text: Antibiotic resistance: natural selection in action
Red: bacteria with the resistance allele. Green: susceptible bacteria.

g.data-info: Survive the antibiotic, reproduce by binary fission and pass on the resistance allele (also spread on plasmids).
A selection pressure. Overuse, using antibiotics for viral infections and not finishing the course all increase resistance.
Bacteria vary. A random mutation has given a few of them an allele for resistance to an antibiotic.
